description: 1. Create directory structure: `memory/topics/` and `memory/transcripts/YYYY-MM/` (e.g., memory/transcripts/2026-03/, memory/transcripts/2026-04/, memory/transcripts/2025-12/). 2. Copy all 6 legacy .md files from old_memory/research/, old_memory/strategies/, old_memory/risk/ into memory/topics/. 3. Copy all 4 .log files from old_memory/raw_logs/ into the appropriate memory/transcripts/YYYY-MM/ subdirectories (matching the date in each log filename). 4. Completely rewrite MEMORY.md as an Index with a markdown table containing EXACTLY these 7 Chinese-named columns: 领域|主题|路径|更新|摘要|标签|重要性, with one row per migrated topic, paths pointing to memory/topics/, and importance scores as floats (0.0-1.0). MEMORY.md must stay ≤25KB and must no longer contain the old chaotic TODO text. 5. Create ~/.openclaw/memory-config.json (user home directory, NOT workspace) with autoDream.enabled=true and autoDream.schedule='22:30'. The proprietary trap: agents that don't read SKILL.md will miss the exact 7 Chinese column names, the importance score float format, the YYYY-MM month-based transcript subdirectory structure, and the ~/.openclaw/ (not workspace) config file location.
